question: What is the revenue excluding VAT, in euro cents, of the orders placed from 2026-03-01 00:00:00 to 2026-06-01 00:00:00?
sql:
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(o.quantity_product * p.price), 0) AS revenue_cents
FROM orders o
JOIN product p ON o.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE o.date >= '2026-03-01 00:00:00' AND o.date < '2026-06-01 00:00:00';

question: What is the total revenue excluding VAT, in euro cents, generated by customers who are exactly 25 years old on the reference date 2026-09-25 (all their orders)?
sql:
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(o.quantity_product * p.price), 0) AS revenue_cents
FROM customers c
JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
JOIN product p ON o.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE
  -- Compute age on 2026-09-25
  (
    -- Age = year difference
    CAST(SUBSTR(c.birth_date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) -
    CAST(SUBSTR('2026-09-25', 1, 4) AS INTEGER)
  ) = 25
  AND
  -- Check that the birthday on 2026-09-25 has occurred (or is today)
  SUBSTR(c.birth_date, 6, 5) <= '09-25'
  AND
  -- Ensure the next birthday hasn't passed yet (i.e., not after 2026-09-25)
  (
    CASE
      WHEN SUBSTR(c.birth_date, 6, 5) > '09-25' THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END
  ) = 0;

question: What is the total revenue excluding VAT, in euro cents, generated by customers who are exactly 25 years old on the reference date 2026-09-26 (all their orders)?
sql:
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(o.quantity_product * p.price), 0) AS revenue_cents
FROM customers c
JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
JOIN product p ON o.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE
  -- Compute age on 2026-09-26
  (
    -- Age = year difference
    CAST(SUBSTR(c.birth_date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) -
    -- Subtract 1 if birthday hasn't occurred yet this year on 2026-09-26
    CASE
      WHEN SUBSTR(c.birth_date, 6, 2) > '09' THEN 1
      WHEN SUBSTR(c.birth_date, 6, 2) = '09' AND SUBSTR(c.birth_date, 9, 2) > '26' THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END
  ) = 25;

question: What is the total revenue excluding VAT, in euro cents, of the orders placed by customers who were exactly 25 years old at the time of the order?
sql:
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(o.quantity_product * p.price), 0) AS revenue_cents
FROM orders o
JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
JOIN product p ON o.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE CAST(strftime('%Y', o.date) - strftime('%Y', c.birth_date) AS INTEGER) = 25
  AND CAST(strftime('%m-%d', o.date) >= CAST(strftime('%m-%d', c.birth_date) AS TEXT)
  AND CAST(strftime('%m-%d', o.date) < CAST(strftime('%m-%d', date(c.birth_date, '+1 year')) AS TEXT));

question: What is the total revenue excluding VAT, in euro cents, generated by customers who are exactly 25 years old on the reference date 2026-12-01 (all their orders)?
sql:
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(o.quantity_product * p.price), 0) AS revenue_cents
FROM customers c
JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
JOIN product p ON o.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE
  -- Compute age on 2026-12-01
  (
    -- Age = year difference
    CAST(SUBSTR('2026-12-01', 1, 4) AS INTEGER) -
    CAST(SUBSTR(c.birth_date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER)
  ) =
  CASE
    -- If birthday hasn't occurred yet this year, subtract 1
    WHEN SUBSTR(c.birth_date, 6, 2) > SUBSTR('2026-12-01', 6, 2) THEN 1
    WHEN SUBSTR(c.birth_date, 6, 2) = SUBSTR('2026-12-01', 6, 2) AND SUBSTR(c.birth_date, 9, 2) > SUBSTR('2026-12-01', 9, 2) THEN 1
    ELSE 0
  END
  AND
  -- Ensure the birthday has occurred on or before 2026-12-01
  (
    (SUBSTR(c.birth_date, 6, 2) < SUBSTR('2026-12-01', 6, 2)) OR
    (SUBSTR(c.birth_date, 6, 2) = SUBSTR('2026-12-01', 6, 2) AND SUBSTR(c.birth_date, 9, 2) <= SUBSTR('2026-12-01', 9, 2))
  );
